title: skills(pm-dispatch): push-notify the maintainer when an item moves into the maintainer's hands
body:
Fixes #24481

Clause-②: no

## What changed

One rule in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, in 升级与决策 beside the card-before-popup and `AskUserQuestion` bullets (previously `:268`–`:271`), as two bullets at `:272`–`:273`:

```text
- 推送维护者:受管 PR 待批合、决策卡待字、发版、仅其可解之阻 ⇒ 另发 `PushNotification`。
- 一行 ≤200 字,先写动作与编号;每项恰一次,例行进展、刚问刚答与在场即见的不推。
```

The maintainer's order, said in the epic seat's chat (`session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`, 2026-10-19) and quoted on the card verbatim:

> 「24422 等我合并，你改过之后没给我推送消息，是skills的问题吗」
>
> 「长期固定下来，立一张skills卡片」

The rule keeps the card's content: the four triggers (a governed PR awaiting approval and merge, a decision card awaiting a word, a release step, a block only the maintainer can clear), the push sent in addition to chat and the GitHub record (另发), one line, ≤200 characters, the action and the number first, exactly once per item, and no push for routine progress, a question just answered, or a maintainer who is present. The card's "⛔ 不以 GitHub assign 代推送(同上条)" is already the existing `:268` bullet (「⛔ 不 assign 推送」), two lines above, so it is not restated.

## Line budget: net 0, paid by deleting duplicated content, not by re-wrapping

`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` pins SKILL.md at 319 lines with headroom 0 and the widest table row at 342 bytes. The two new bullets are paid for by deleting two bullets whose content lives verbatim-equivalent in `references/lanes/director.md`, which the director seat reads (`:56` already pointed there):

- deleted 「三职 = 契约复核记录事后审计、决裁勤务、维护者动作台账。」 — director.md's three 职责 headers (`:29`, `:45`, `:60`);
- deleted 「每场召唤把带席内 ACCEPT 的受管草稿呈为一批 ≤5 行决裁;批准与合并仍是维护者的点击。」 — director.md `:53`–`:54`, and AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 ("ONE batch of at most five rows, and the click stays the maintainer's");
- the `director` row of the args table (`:56`) now reads 「三职与章程见 `references/lanes/director.md`」 instead of pointing at this section for the three duties.

No neighbouring bullet was folded or re-wrapped: the dev role file names re-wrap as not a legal currency for the line ratchet (「⛔ 不拿 re-wrap(折行合并)当筹行,新增以删减付账」), and every prose bullet in this file is ≤120 bytes, which a two-bullet fold cannot keep. The dispatch's fallback (stop and report candidate folds) was therefore not needed; the alternative folds are listed in the report comment on the card for the record. Result: 319 → 319 lines; 3 insertions, 3 deletions; every changed line ≤120 bytes (56: 117, 272: 118, 273: 112).

## The dispatch's measurement points

- Mirror line: none added. The round-report duty lives in `references/seat-lifecycle.md:66`–`:68` (「轮次报告与节奏」); `references/execution-duties.md` carries no round-report duty (its only 轮报 mention, `:54`, is a triage-gap line); seat Routine prompts live in each session's scheduled task, not in the tree. `seat-lifecycle.md` is outside the claim's surface and was not edited.
- Issue-id lint: `scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` refuses `/#[0-9]{3,}/` in this file, so the card's example 「#24422 ADR 待您合并」 cannot appear in the rule; the rule states the format ("先写动作与编号") and carries no example (an `#N` example did not fit the 120-byte line norm with the exclusions kept).
- The `PushNotification` tool: the name is the card's. No reference to it exists in the tracked tree, in `.claude/settings.json`, in `.claude/hooks/`, or in this container's tool list (a ToolSearch for "push notification" returned no such tool), so the card's 「工具回 not sent 即视为在场,不重发」 clause is unsourced here and was not written; 「每项恰一次」 and 「在场即见的不推」 carry the once-only intent without a claim about the tool's return value.
- Tier: the card and the dispatch call this PR Tier H. The register (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, row `claude-tree`), AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 and SKILL.md `:204` all place `.claude/**` in Tier S. The posture here is the same either way: the PR is opened as draft and stays draft; this agent never readies, queues or arms it; landing waits for the tier's record.
- Acceptance item 2 (the next item moving into the maintainer's hands gets exactly one push, recorded in a round report) is the seat's post-landing reading, not part of this PR.
- Changeset: `.claude/**` publishes nothing, so `skip-changeset` is applied at PR creation.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:在 pm-dispatch 技能的〈升级与决策〉里加了一条规则:事项转入您手上时(受管 PR 等您批准合并、决策卡等您回字、发版步骤、只有您能解的阻塞),席位除了聊天和 GitHub 记录之外,再给您发一条推送通知;一行、先写要做的动作和编号;每项只推一次;例行进展、刚问刚答、您在场看得见的不推。为了不超过文件的行数上限,删掉了两条总监席的细则(三职清单、每场呈批 ≤5 行),它们在 `references/lanes/director.md` 里原样都有;参数表里 `director` 一行改为只指向该文件。

**为什么改**:2026-10-19 PR 24422 已经通过评审、等您合并,席位只在聊天里说了一句,没有推送,您不在那个会话就不知道。您的原话:「24422 等我合并，你改过之后没给我推送消息，是skills的问题吗」「长期固定下来，立一张skills卡片」。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改一个技能文件的文字,不加门禁、不发布任何包。风险一:席位推送过多——规则用「四类触发」「每项恰一次」和三条不推情形来限;风险二:`PushNotification` 这个工具名来自卡片,本容器里查不到它,席位会话里是否存在未实测,若不存在,席位应在轮次报告里说明。回滚 = revert 本 PR 一个提交,文件回到 319 行原样。

**席位意见**:(留空,由席位填写)

**你要做的**:一个动作——审阅后批准并合并本 PR(受管面,席位不代合)。

## Acceptance notes

- The card and the dispatch call this PR Tier H; the register and AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 place `.claude/**` in Tier S. Not a defect in the tree; noted for the seat (carrier: the dispatching seat), not filed.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet` prints a pre-existing info line unrelated to this diff: `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` max-table-row-bytes headroom is 2 (pin 326, measured 324), which the gate invites a future PR to lower. Observation only; carrier: none; not filed.
- The round-report duty in `references/seat-lifecycle.md:66`–`:68` does not mention the push; the dispatch ruled no mirror line, so none was added. Observation only.
